summary: Candidate is a knowledge_reference for statistical distribution random variate generation via D3, distinct from existing skills which cover text retrieval metrics (tf-idf, cf/df) and D3 visualization APIs (selection, shapes, axes). No semantic overlap with existing registry. Single support evidence confirms D3 random distribution API exists. Asset type, granularity, domain, task_family, and method_family are all appropriate and non-conflicting.
